briefdescription.para: PolyRingQuotient polynomial ring modulo an ideal whose Groebner basis is known.

detaileddescription.para: Declares the concrete PolyRingFlat subclass for R / I (sibling of PolyRing from poly.hpp both inherit directly from PolyRingFlat, not from each other), where R is the ambient ring and I is a polynomial ideal carried in a QRingInfo bookkeeping struct (declared in qring.hpp). QRingInfo keeps the defining ideal's generators twice as Nterm* for ring-element arithmetic and as gbvector* for GB-internal reduction so multiplication, inversion, and every other operation in the quotient finishes with a reduction against the stored GB without having to convert representations on each call. The class overrides normal_form to delegate to qinfo_->normal_form, plus make_gb(g) (build a GB for the principal ideal (g) inside the quotient) and ann(a, b) (return h with h * a in (b)).

Built from M2 by R = k[xs]; I = ideal(...); Q = R/I; the factory rejects trivial ideals (returns the ambient R unchanged) and routes through PolynomialRing to wire up the resulting PolyRingQuotient into the engine's ring hierarchy.
